text_types.name: Öffentliche Hinweisschilder & Öffnungszeiten
text_types.description: Signs at shops, doctor's offices, banks, and bakeries specifying operating hours.
key_phrases: Geöffnet von ... bis ...: Open from ... to ...
Sonn- und Feiertage: Sundays and public holidays
text_types.exam_tip: Carefully check the specific day mentioned in the question (e.g. Samstag) against the notice's day brackets.

text_types.name: Private E-Mails, SMS & Einladungen
text_types.description: Short correspondence about parties, meetings, holidays, or daily updates.
key_phrases: Ich lade dich herzlich zu ... ein
Bitte bring etwas zu essen/trinken mit
Sag mir bitte bis Freitag Bescheid
text_types.exam_tip: Identify the 4 key facts: Host (Wer?), Date/Time (Wann?), Location (Wo?), and Task/Items (Was mitbringen?).

text_types.name: Kleinanzeigen & Wohnungsangebote
text_types.description: Short ads for apartments, jobs, or items for sale with common abbreviations.
key_abbreviations: ab 1. Mai frei = available from May 1st
text_types.exam_tip: Beware of negative constraints like 'Keine Haustiere' or 'Nichtraucher'.

text_types.name: Fahrpläne, Bahnhofs- & Flughafenanzeigen
text_types.description: Notices regarding platform changes, delays, cancellations, and route updates.
key_phrases: fährt heute ausnahmsweise von Gleis 7 ab: departs exceptionally from platform 7 today
Verspätung ca. ... Minuten: delayed by ... minutes
Zug fällt aus: train is canceled
Grund ist eine Reparatur / Störung: reason is a repair / disruption
text_types.exam_tip: Distinguish between scheduled plan (planmäßig) and current exception (heute ausnahmsweise).
